1.1: Shammay omer, kol hannashim dayyan sheatan. hillel omer, mippekida lifkida, vaafillu leyamim harebe. vachachamim omrim, lo chedivre ze velo chedivre ze, ella meet leet memaet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet. kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. vehameshammeshet beiddim, hare zo chifkida, umemaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida:
1.2: Ketzad dayyah sheatah. hayta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka vetohorot, ufersha veraata, hi temea vechullan tehorot. af al pi sheamru, metammea meet leet, enah mona ella mishshaa sheraata:
1.3: Rabbi eliezer omer, arba nashim dayyan sheatan, betula, meubberet, menika uzekena. amar rabbi yehoshua, ani lo shamati ella vetula, aval halacha kerabbi eliezer:
1.4: Ezo hi vetula, kol shello raata dam miyyameha, af al pi shennesua. meubberet, mishsheyyivvada ubbarah. menika, ad shettigmol et benah. natna venah lemenika, gemalattu o met, rabbi meir omer, metammea meet leet. vachachamim omrim, dayyah sheatah:
1.5: Ezohi zekena. kol sheavru aleha shalosh onot samuch leziknatah. rabbi eliezer omer, kol ishsha sheavru aleha shalosh onot, dayyah sheatah. rabbi yose omer, meubberet umenika sheavru alehen shalosh onot, dayyan sheatan:
1.6: Uvamme amru dayyah sheatah. biriyya rishona. aval bashsheniyya, metammea meet leet. veim raata harishona meones, af hashsheniyya dayyah sheatah:
1.7: Af al pi sheamru dayyah sheatah, tzericha lihyot bodeket, chutz min hannidda vehayyoshevet al dam tohar. umeshammeshet beiddim, chutz miyyoshevet al dam tohar, uvetula sheddameha tehorim. ufaamayim tzericha lihyot bodeket, beshacharit uven hashshemashot, uveshaa shehi overet leshammesh et betah. yetera alehen kohanot, beshaa shehen ochlot batteruma. rabbi yehuda omer, af bishat avaratan milleechol batteruma:

2.1: Kol hayyad hammarba livdok benashim, meshubbachat. uvaanashim, tikkatzetz. hachereshet vehashshota vehassuma veshennitrefa datah, im yesh lahen pikchot, metakkenot otan vehen ochlot batteruma. derech benot yisrael, meshammeshot bishne iddim, echad lo veechad lah. hatztzenuot metakkenot lahen shelishi, letakken et habbayit:
2.2: Nimtza al shello, temein vechayyavin karban. nimtza al shellah otyom, temein vechayyavin karban. nimtza al shellah leachar zeman, temeim missafek ufeturim min hakkarban:
2.3: Ezehu achar zeman. kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha. veachar kach, metammea meet leet veenah metammea et boalah. rabbi akiva omer, af metammea et boalah. umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa chetem, shemmetammea et boalah:
2.4: Kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levaalehen. habbain min hadderech, neshehen lahen bechezkat tohora. bet shammay omrim, tzericha shene iddim al kol tashmish vetashmish, o teshammesh leor hanner. bet hillel omrim, dayyah bishne iddim kol hallayla:
2.5: Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha, hacheder vehapperozdor vehaaliyya. dam hacheder, tame. nimtza vapperozdor, sefeko tame, lefi shechezkato min hammakor:
2.6: Chamishsha damim temeim baishsha. haadom, vehashshachor, uchekeren karkom, uchememe adama, uchemazug. bet shammay omrim, af kememe tiltan uchememe vasar tzali. uvet hillel metaharin. hayyarok, akavya ven mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharim. amar rabbi meir, im eno metamme mishshum ketem, metamme mishshum mashke. rabbi yose omer, lo chach velo chach:
2.7: Ezehu adom, kedam hammakka. shachor, kacheret. amok mikkan, tame. dehe mikkan, tahor. uchekeren karkom, kabbarur shebbo. uchememe adama, mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif mayim. uchemazug, shene chalakim mayim veechad yayin, min hayyayin hashsharoni:

3.1: Hammappelet chaticha, im yesh immah dam, temea. veim lav, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, ben kach uven kach, temea:
3.2: Hammappelet kemin kelippa, kemin saara, kemin afar, kemin yavchushim adummim, tattil lammayim. im nimmochu, temea. veim lav, tehora. hammappelet kemin dagim, chagavim, shekatzim uremasim, im yesh immahem dam, temea. veim lav, tehora. hammappelet min behema, chayya vaof, ben temein ben tehorim, im zachar, teshev lezachar. veim nekeva, teshev linkeva. veim en yadua, teshev lezachar velinkeva, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam, eno valad:
3.3: Hammappelet shefir male mayim, male dam, male genunim, enah chosheshet levalad. veim haya merukkam, teshev lezachar velinkeva:
3.4: Hammappelet sandal o shilya, teshev lezachar velinkeva. shilya babbayit, habbayit tame. lo shehashshilya valad, ella sheen shilya velo valad. rabbi shimon omer, nimmok havvalad ad shello yatza:
3.5: Hammappelet tumtum, veanderoginos, teshev lezachar velinkeva. tumtum vezachar, anderoginos vezachar, teshev lezachar velinkeva. tumtum unekeva, anderoginos unekeva, teshev linkeva vilvad. yatza mechuttach o mesoras, mishsheyyatza rubbo, hare hu cheyalud. yatza chedarko, ad sheyyetze rov rosho. veezehu rov rosho, mishshettetze faddachto:
3.6: Hammappelet veen yadua ma hu, teshev lezachar velinkeva. en yadua im valad haya im lav, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda:
3.7: Hammappelet leyom arbaim, enah chosheshet levalad. leyom arbaim veechad, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda. rabbi yishmael omer, yom arbaim veechad, teshev lezachar ulenidda. yom shemonim veechad, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda, shehazzachar nigmar learbaim veechad, vehannekeva lishmonim veechad. vachachamim omrim, echad beriyyat hazzachar veechad beriyyat hannekeva, ze vaze learbaim veechad:

4.1: Benot kutim, niddot mearisatan. vehakkutim metammeim mishkav tachton kaelyon, mippene shehen boale niddot, vehen yoshvot al kol dam vadam. veen chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma, mippene shettumatan safek:
4.2: Benot tzedokin, bizman shennahagu lalechet bedarche avotehen, hare hen kechutiyyot. pershu lalechet bedarche yisrael, hare hen keyisreelit. rabbi yose omer, leolam hen keyisrael, ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen:
4.3: Dam nachrit vedam tohora shel metzoraat, bet shammay metaharim. uvet hillel omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. dam yoledet shello tavla, bet shammay omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. uvet hillel omrim, metamme lach veyavesh. umodim beyoledet bezov, shehi metammea lach veyavesh:
4.4: Hammaksha, nidda. kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom veshafta meet leet veyalda, hare zo yoledet bezov, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, layla vayom, kelele shabbat veyomo. sheshshafta min hatztzaar, velo min haddam:
4.5: Kamma hu kishshuyah. rabbi meir omer, afillu arbaim vachamishshim yom. rabbi yehuda omer, dayyah chadshah. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, en kishshuy yoter mishshete shabbatot:
4.6: Hammaksha vetoch shemonim shel nekeva, kol damim shehi roa, tehorim, ad sheyyetze havvalad. verabbi eliezer metamme. amru lo lerabbi eliezer, uma bimkom shehechmir bedam hashshofi, hekel bedam hakkoshi, mekom shehekel bedam hashshofi, eno din shennakel bedam hakkoshi. amar lahen, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, mimma hekel aleha, mittumat ziva, aval temea tumat nidda:
4.7: Kol achad asar yom bechezkat tohora. yashva lah velo vadka, shagga, neensa, hezida velo vadka, tehora. higgia sheat vistah velo vadka, hare zo temea. rabbi meir omer, im hayta vemachave vehiggia sheat vistah, velo vadka, hare zo tehora, mippene shecharada mesalleket et haddamim. aval yeme hazzav vehazzava veshomeret yom keneged yom, hare ellu bechezkat tuma:

5.1: Yotze dofen, en yoshvin alav yeme tuma vime tohora, veen chayyavin alav karban. rabbi shimon omer, hare ze cheyalud. kol hannashim mittammeot babbayit hachitzon, shenneemar (Vayikra 15:19), dam yihye zovah bivsarah. aval hazzav uvaal keri, enan mittammeim, ad shettetze tumatan lachutz:
5.2: Haya ochel batteruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav, ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma. umetammeim bechol shehu, afillu cheen hachardal uvefachot mikkan:
5.3: Tinoket bat yom echad, mittammea venidda. bat asara yamim, mittammea veziva. tinok ben yom echad, mittamme veziva, umittamme vingaim, umittamme vitme met, vezokek leyibbum, ufoter min hayyibbum, umaachil batteruma, ufosel min hatteruma, venochel umanchil. vehahorgo, chayyav. vahare hu leaviv uleimmo ulechol kerovav kechatan shalem:
5.4: Bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, mitkaddeshet bevia. veim ba aleha yavam, kenaah. vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish, umetammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. nisset lechohen, tochal batteruma. ba aleha achad min happesulim, pesalah min hakkehunna. ba aleha achad mikkol haarayot haamurot battora, mumatin al yadah, vehi fetura. pachot mikkan, kenoten etzba baayin:
5.5: Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, kenaah. veeno noten get ad sheyyagdil. umittamme venidda, letamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. ufosel veeno maachil batteruma. ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach, veniskelet al yado. veim ba al achat mikkol haarayot haamurot battora, mumatim al yado, vehu fatur:
5.6: Bat achat esre shana veyom echad, nedareha nivdakin. bat shetem esre shana veyom echad, nedareha kayyamin. uvodkin kol shetem esre. ben shetem esre shana veyom echad, nedarav nivdakim. ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad, nedarav kayyamin. uvodkin kol shelosh esre. kodem lazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru yodin anu leshem mi nadarnu, leshem mi hikdashnu, en nidrehem neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh. leachar hazzeman hazze, af al pi sheamru en anu yodin leshem mi nadarnu, leshem mi hikdashnu, nidran neder vehekdeshan hekdesh:
5.7: Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha. pagga, bochal vetzemel. pagga, odah tinoket. bochal, ellu yeme neureha. bazo uvazo, aviha zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha uvahafarat nedareha. tzemel, kevan shebbagra, shuv en leaviha reshut bah:
5.8: Ezehu simaneha. rabbi yose haggelili omer, mishsheyyaale hakkemet tachat haddad. rabbi akiva omer, mishsheyyattu haddaddim. ben azzay omer, mishshettashchir happittomet. rabbi yose omer, kede sheyyehe noten yado al haoketz vehu shokea veshohe lachazor:
5.9: Bat esrim shana shello hevia shete searot, tavi reaya shehi vat esrim shana, vehi aylonit, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. ben esrim shana shello hevi shete searot, yavi reaya shehu ven esrim shana, vehu saris, lo choletz velo meyabbem, ellu divre vet hillel. bet shammay omrim, ze vaze bene shemone esre. rabbi eliezer omer, hazzachar kedivre vet hillel, vehannekeva kedivre vet shammay, shehaishsha memaheret lavo lifne haish:

6.1: Ba siman hattachton ad shello va haelyon, o choletzet o mityyabbemet. ba haelyon ad shello va hattachton, af al pi shei efshar, rabbi meir omer, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. vachachamim omrim, o choletzet o mityabbemet. mippene sheamru, efshar lattachton lavo ad shello va haelyon, aval i efshar laelyon lavo ad shello va hattachton:
6.2: Kayyotze vo, kol keli cheres shehu machnis, motzi. veyesh shemmotzi veeno machnis. kol evar sheyyesh bo tzipporen, yesh bo etzem, veyesh sheyyesh bo etzem veen bo tzipporen:
6.3: Kol hammittamme midras, mittamme teme met. veyesh shemmittamme teme met veeno mittamme midras:
6.4: Kol harauy ladun dine nefashot, rauy ladun dine mamonot. veyesh sherauy ladun dine mamonot veeno rauy ladun dine nefashot. kol hakkasher ladun, kasher lehaid. veyesh shekkasher lehaid veeno chasher ladun:
6.5: Kol shechayyav bammaasrot, mittamme tumat ochalim. veyesh shemmittamme tumat ochalin veeno chayyav bammaasrot:
6.6: Kol shechayyav bappea, chayyav bammaasrot. veyesh shechayyav bammaasrot veeno chayyav bappea:
6.7: Kol shechayyav bereshit haggez, chayyav bammattanot. veyesh shechayyav bammattanot veeno chayyav bereshit haggez:
6.8: Kol sheyyesh lo viur, yesh lo sheviit. veyesh sheyyesh lo sheviit veen lo viur:
6.9: Kol sheyyesh lo kaskeset, yesh lo senappir. veyesh sheyyesh lo senappir veen lo kaskeset. kol sheyyesh lo karnayim, yesh lo telafayim. veyesh sheyyesh lo telafayim veen lo karnayim:
6.10: Kol hattaun beracha leacharav, taun beracha lefanav. veyesh taun beracha lefanav veen taun beracha leacharav:
6.11: Tinoket shehevia shete searot, o choletzet o mityabbemet, vechayyevet bechol mitzvot haamurot battora. vechen tinok shehevi shete searot, chayyav bechol mitzvot haamurot battora. verauy lihyot ben sorer umore, mishsheyyavi shete searot ad sheyyakkif zakan, hattachton velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim belashon nekiyya. tinoket shehevia shete searot, enah yechola lemaen. rabbi yehuda omer, ad sheyyirbe hashshachor:
6.12: Shete searot haamurot bappara uvannegaim, vehaamurot bechol makom, kede lachof roshan leikkaran, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi elazar omer, kede likrotz batztzipporen. rabbi akiva omer, kede sheyyehu nittalot bezug:
6.13: Haroa chetem, hare zo mekulkelet, vechosheshet mishshum zov, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en bakketamim mishshum zov:
6.14: Haroa yom achad asar ben hashshemashot, techillat nidda vesof nidda, techillat ziva vesof ziva, yom arbaim lazzachar veyom shemonim lannekeva, ben hashshemashot lechullan, hare ellu toot. amar rabbi yehoshua, ad sheattem metakkenim et hashshotot, takkenu et happikchot:

7.1: Dam hannidda uvesar hammet, metammein lachin umetammein yeveshin. aval hazzov vehannia veharok vehashsheretz vehannevela vehashshichvat zera, metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin. veim yecholin lehishsharot velachazor lichmot shehen, metammein lachin umetammein yeveshin. vechamma hi sheriyyatan. befoshrin, meet leet. rabbi yose omer, besar hammet yavesh veeno yachol lehishsharot velachazor lichmot shehaya, tahor:
7.2: Hashsheretz shennimtza bammavoy, metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar badakti et hammavoy hazze velo haya vo sheretz, o ad sheat kibbud. vechen ketem shennimtza vechaluk, metamme lemafrea, ad sheyyomar badakti et hechaluk hazze velo haya vo chetem, o ad sheat hakkibbus. umetamme ben lach ben yavesh. rabbi shimon omer, hayyavesh metamme lemafrea, vehallach eno metamme ella ad shaa shehu yachol lachazor velihyot lach:
7.3: Kol hakketamin habbaim merekem, tehorin. rabbi yehuda metamme, mippene shehem gerim vetoin. habbain mibben haggoyim, tehorin. mibben yisrael umibben hakkutim, rabbi meir metamme. vachachamim metaharin, mippene shello nechshedu al kitmehen:
7.4: Kol hakketamim hannimtzeim bechol makom, tehorin, chutz min hannimtzeim bachadarim uvisvivot bet hattumot. bet hattumot shel kutim metammein beohel, mippene shehem kovrin sham et hannefalim. rabbi yehuda omer, lo hayu kovrin ella mashlichin, vechayya gorartan:
7.5: Neemanim lomar, kavarnu sham et hannefalim, o, lo kavarnu. neemanim lomar al habbehema im bikkera, im lo vikkera. neemanim al tziyyun kevarot, veen neemanin lo al hassechachot velo al happeraot velo al bet happeras. ze hakkelal, davar shechashudim bo, en neemanim alav:

8.1: Haroa chetem al besarah keneged bet hatturpa temea. veshello cheneged bet hatturpa, tehora. al akevah veal rosh gudalah, temea. al shokah veal parsoteha, mibbifnim, temea. mibbachutz, tehora. veal hatztzedadin mikkan umikkan, tehora. raata al chalukah, min hachagor ulematta, temea. min hachagor ulemala, tehora. raata al bet yad shel chaluk, im maggia keneged bet hatturpa, temea. veim lav, tehora. hayta foshatto umitkassa vo ballayla, kol makom shennimtza vo chetem, temea, mippene shehu chozer. vechen bappalyom:
8.2: Vetola vechol davar shehi yechola litlot. shachata vehema, chayya vaof, nitasseka vichtamim o sheyyashva vetzad haasukim bahen, harga maacholet, hare zo tola vah. ad kamma hi tola. rabbi chanina ven antignos omer, ad kaggeris shel pol, veaf al pi shello harga. vetola vivnah o bevalah. im yesh bah makka vehi yechola lehiggala ulehotzi dam, hare zo tola vah:
8.3: Maase veishsha achat shebbat lifne rabbi akiva, amra lo, raiti chatem. amar lah, shemma makka hayta vich. amra lo, hen, vechayta. amar lah, shemma yechola lehiggala ulehotzi dam. amra lo, hen. vetiharah rabbi akiva. raa talmidav mistakkelin ze vaze. amar lahem, ma haddavar kashe veenechem. shello amru chachamim haddavar lehachemir ella lehakel, shenneemar (Vayikra 15), veishsha ki tihye zava dam yihye zovah bivsarah, dam velo chatem:
8.4: Ed shehu natun tachat hakkar venimtza alav dam, agol, tahor. mashuch, tame, divre rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok:

9.1: Haishsha shehi osa tzeracheha veraata dam, rabbi meir omer, im omedet, temea. veim yoshevet, tehora. rabbi yose omer, ben kach uven kach, tehora:
9.2: Ish veishsha sheasu tzerachehen letoch hassefel venimtza dam al hammayim, rabbi yose metaher. verabbi shimon metamme, sheen derech haish lehotzi dam, ella shechezkat damim min haishsha:
9.3: Hishila chalukah lenachrit o lenidda, hare zo tola vah. shalosh nashim shellavshu chaluk echad o sheyyashvu al safsal echad, venimtza alav dam, kullan temeot. yashvu al safsal shel even o al haitztabba shel merchatz, rabbi nechemya metaher, shehaya rabbi nechemya omer, kol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma, eno mekabbel ketamim:
9.4: Shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat achat mehen, kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet temea, hi temea ushetehen tehorot, vetolot zo vazo. veim lo hayu reuyot lirot, roin otan keillu hen reuyot:
9.5: Shalosh nashim shehayu yeshenot bemitta achat venimtza dam tachat haemtzait, kullan temeot. tachat happenimit, shetayim happenimiyyot temeot vehachitzona tehora. tachat hachitzona, shetayim hachitzonot temeot vehappenimit tehora. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman sheavru derech margelot hammitta. aval im avru shelashtan derech aleha, kullan temeot. badka achat mehen venimtzet tehora, hi tehora ushetayim temeot. badku shetayim umatzu tehorot, hen tehorot vehashshelishit temea. shelashtan umatzu tehorot, kullan temeot. lema haddavar dome, legal tame shennitarev ben shene gallim tehorim, uvadku achad mehen umatzu tahor, hu tahor ushenayim temein. shenayim umatzu tehorim, hem tehorim vehashshelishi tame. shelashtan umatzu tehorim, kullan temeim, divre rabbi meir, shehaya rabbi meir omer, kol davar shehu vechezkat tuma, leolam hu vetumato, ad sheyyivvada lecha, tuma hechan hi. vachachamim omrim, bodek ad shemmaggia lesela o livtula:
9.6: Shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem. rok tafel, ume gerisin, ume raglayim, veneter, uvorit, kemuneya, veeshlag. hitbilo veasa al gabbav tohorot, heevir alav shiva sammanin velo avar, hare ze tzeva, hattohorot tehorot, veeno tzarich lehatebil. avar o sheddeha, hare ze chetem, vehattohorot temeot, vetzarich lehatebil:
9.7: Ezehu rok tafel, kol shello taam kelum. me gerisin, leissat gerisin shel pol, chalukat nafesh. me raglayim, shehechemitzu. vetzarich lechaskes shalosh peamim lechol echad veechad. heeviran shello chesidran, o sheheevir shiva sammanin keachat, lo asa velo chelum:
9.8: Kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. veellu hen havvesatot, mefaheket, umeatteshet, vechosheshet befi cheresah, uveshippule meeha, veshofaat, uchemin tzemarmorot ochazin otah, vechen kayyotze vahen. vechol shekkava lah shalosh peamim, hare zo vaset:
9.9: Hayta lemuda lihyot roa vitchillat havvesatot, kol hattohorot sheasta vetoch havvesatot, temeot. besof havvesatot, kol hattohorot sheasta vetoch havvesatot, tehorot. rabbi yose omer, af yamim veshaot, vesatot. hayta lemuda lihyot roa im hanetz hachamma, enah asura ella im hanetz hachamma. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hayyom shellah:
9.10: Hayta lemuda lihyot roa yom chamishsha asar veshinneta lihyot roa leyom esrim, ze vaze asurin. shinneta faamayim leyom esrim, ze vaze asurin. shinneta shalosh peamim leyom esrim, huttar chamishsha asar vekava lah yom esrim, sheen ishsha kovaat lah veset, ad shettikbaenna shalosh peamim. veenah mittaheret havveset, ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim:
9.11: Nashim bivtulehem kaggefanim. yesh gefen sheyyenah adom, veyesh gefen sheyyenah shachor, veyesh gefen sheyyenah merubbe, veyesh gefen sheyyenah muat. rabbi yehuda omer, kol gefen yesh bah yayin. vesheen bah yayin, hare ze dorketi:

10.1: Tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim, notnin lah arbaa lelot. uvet hillel omrim, ad shettichye hammakka. higgia zemannah lirot venisset, bet shammay omrim, notnin lah layla harishon. uvet hillel omrim, ad motzae shabbat, arbaa lelot. raata veodah bevet aviha, bet shammay omrim, notnin lah beilat mitzva. uvet hillel omrim, kol hallayla kullah:
10.2: Nidda shebbadka atzmah yom shevii shacharit umatzta tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar yamim badka umatzta temea, hare hi vechezkat tohora. badka atzmah bayyom hashshevii beshacharit umatzta temea, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar zeman badka umatzta tehora, hare zo vechezkat tuma, umetammea meet leet umippekida lifkida. veim yesh lah veset, dayyah sheatah. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shello hifrisha vetohora min hammincha ulemala, hare zo vechezkat tuma. vachachamim omrim, afillu vashsheniyya leniddatah badka umatzta tehora, uven hashshemashot lo hifrisha, uleachar zeman badka umatza temea, hare zo vechezkat tohora:
10.3: Hazzav vehazzava shebbadku atzman beyom rishon umatzu tahor, uvayyom hashshevii umatzu tahor, ushear yamim shebbentayim lo vadku, rabbi eliezer omer, hare hen bechezkat tohora. rabbi yehoshua omer, en lahem ella yom rishon veyom shevii vilvad. rabbi akiva omer, en lahem ella yom shevii vilvad:
10.4: Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet vehametzora shemmetu, metammein bemassa ad sheyyimmok habbasar. nachri shemmet, tahor milletamme vemassa. bet shammay omrim, kol hannashim metot niddot. uvet hillel omrim, en nidda ella shemmeta nidda:
10.5: Haishsha shemmeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam, metammea mishshum ketem, umetammea veohel. rabbi yehuda omer, enah metammea mishshum ketem, mippene shenneekar mishshemmeta. umode rabbi yehuda beyoshevet al mashber umeta veyatza mimmenna reviit dam, shehi metammea mishshum ketem. amar rabbi yose, lefichach enah metammea veohel:
10.6: Barishona hayu omrim, hayyoshevet al dam tohar, hayta meara mayim lappesach. chazru lomar, hare hi chemagga teme met lakkadashim, kedivre vet hillel. bet shammay omrim, af kitme met:
10.7: Umodim shehi ochelet bammaaser, vekotza lah challa, umakkefet vekora lah shem. veim nafal merukkah umiddam tohorah al kikkar shel teruma, shehu tahor. bet shammay omrim, tzericha tevila baacharona. uvet hillel omrim, enah tzericha tevila baacharona:
10.8: Haroa yom achad asar vetavla laerev veshimmesha, bet shammay omrim, metammein mishkav umoshav, vechayyavin bakkarban. uvet hillel omrim, peturin min hakkarban. tavla vayom shelleacharav veshimmesha et betah veachar kach raata, bet shammay omrim, metammein mishkav umoshav ufeturim min hakkarban. uvet hillel omrim, hare ze gargeran. umodim beroa vetoch achad asar yom vetavla laerev veshimmesha, shemmetammein mishkav umoshav vechayyavin bakkarban. tavla vayyom shelleacharav veshimmesha, hare zo tarbut raa, umaggaan uveilatan teluyim:
